name: trendhub-mcp
displayName: TrendHub · 全网热点趋势专家
description: 专业级 Agent-native 趋势情报 MCP：21 个稳定工具 + MCP Resources、统一 Evidence Contract v1、Skill 2.0、51 个运行时适配器与 129 个分层信源；v1.6.2 修正公网 Source Universe Truth 展示。

requires.git: recommended for public-stable clone/update; AI should install Git from a trusted OS or official source if missing

bootstrap.integrity: verify the official SHASUMS256.txt SHA-256 before extraction
bootstrap.installScope: portable runtime in user cache; no administrator rights and no system Node replacement
bootstrap.behavior: Reuse existing Node >=22. If Node is missing or below 22, prepare verified portable Node 24 LTS, prepend it only for the install process, then continue setup.mjs -> npm ci -> build -> smoke.

mcpConfigFromResult.note: Configure the MCP client with command=<returned absolute node path> and args=[<returned absolute launcher path>]. This is required when bootstrap used a portable Node runtime that is not on the user's global PATH.

mcpStdio.note: Direct-install default when Node is globally available. After Node-free bootstrap, prefer the absolute node/launcher paths emitted in AI_BOOTSTRAP_OK.

aiInstall.note: AI 安装器拿到仓库链接后可直接 clone；若 Git 缺失先从可信系统源/官方源安装 Git；进入 projectDir 后优先执行平台 bootstrap，并用 AI_BOOTSTRAP_OK 返回的绝对路径写入 MCP 配置。无需用户预装 Node、无需注册/登录、无需模型 API Key 或中央服务器。

transports.note: 启动包装器：先启动当前已验证版本，再后台检查 GitHub Stable Release；仅正式 release 可自动升级，不追 main HEAD；失败时尽力回滚。TRENTHUB_AUTOUPDATE=0 可关闭。Node-free bootstrap 用户应使用 AI_BOOTSTRAP_OK 返回的绝对 Node 路径作为 command。

transports.auth: loopback 默认免鉴权；非 loopback 监听必须设置 TRENTHUB_HTTP_TOKEN，并使用 Authorization: Bearer <token>

console.note: 本地可视化控制台：只做数据可视化与手动触发，不接任何大模型、不写成稿。

runtime.selftestCompatibility: 保留旧命令；等价于 npm run source:health

autoUpdate.failureMode: fail-open + rollback：网络/无 release/本地 tracked 修改时不更新；安装或构建失败时尽力恢复更新前版本
autoUpdate.network: GitHub Releases API + git release tag；不跟随 main HEAD

remote.note: Public distribution adapter. The hosted gateway exposes Remote MCP plus the responsive read/query TrendHub web console. Local-only mutating routes such as /api/snapshot remain private. No visitor XHS_COOKIE is used.

sourceReliability.privacy: stores only timestamp, quality, latency, item count and coarse failure class; no query text, cookies, user content, hostname, IP, account identifiers or model prompts

aiPolicy.note: 插件不内置、不要求任何大模型 API Key。分析成文与创作由调用方 AI（ChatGPT/Claude/豆包/DeepSeek/Gemini/Cursor 等）用其自身算力完成；插件提供实时数据、确定性分析、趋势情报指标与创作脚手架。
aiPolicy.network: 运行取数时仅向目标公开数据源发起必要请求；安装依赖会访问 npm registry/npmmirror；Node bootstrap 访问 nodejs.org；更新只访问 GitHub Stable Release。HTTP 默认绑定 127.0.0.1，非 loopback 必须配置 Bearer Token。
aiPolicy.console: npm run ui 启动本地可视化控制台；控制台零模型 Key、零第三方遥测，趋势判断与脚本/文案/方案成稿仍由调用方 AI 完成。

dataPolicy.note: 缺失即显式标记 missing/degraded，绝不用 0 或‘未知’静默填充，不估算、不造假。Google Trends 数值为 0-100 相对热度，非绝对搜索量。
